elsewhere.note: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as…
